messages:
sana: Quick heads-up — while onboarding the quant4x build of magnet-16b for longcontext tests I hit a rollforward divergence crossing a shard boundary. repeating prompt produces duplicated tokens after ~4k tokens.

ev an: :eyes: can you paste the minimal repro and logs?

sana: repro command below (ran on staging-dedicated-gpu-2):
```bash
./run_infer --model magnet-16b-quant4x --prompt-file tests/longspan/anchor_8k.txt --max-tokens 2048 --batch 1 --kv-mode rollforward
```

sana: snippet of stderr when it diverges (trimmed):
```
[2025-06-12T09:15:03Z] kv-rollforward: shard=2 idx=4095 -> mapped_idx=0
[2025-06-12T09:15:03Z] kv-checksum: expected=0x7a3f4c got=0x7a3f4c
[2025-06-12T09:15:03Z] generate: token=1345 text="the"
[2025-06-12T09:15:04Z] generate: token=1345 text="the"  <-- duplicated output starts here
[2025-06-12T09:15:04Z] kv-rollforward: tail_offset=1 len=512
```

evan: hm checksum matched but output duplicated — suggests index remap is reusing a slot without repopulating its KV values (or KV lookup returning stale vectors). did you run an int->float unpack check?

sana: did a quick compare between float32 and quant4x: float32 run on same prompt produced no duplication. quant4x shows repeat and small next-token prob skew.

marc: pinging in case this is the rotary-phase / index remap we've seen before on narrower longprefill cases. can you dump the kcache keys around the boundary?

sana: dumped keys: attached block: (format key_idx:hex)
```
4094: a1b2c3...
4095: deadbe...
0: a1b2c3...  <-- key at 0 matches 4094 after remap
1: 000000...  <-- zeroed slot
```

sana: looks like remap moved 4095->0 but slot 0's values appear not refreshed for some heads (some heads are zeros). that would explain duplication since attention reads fallback pattern.

ops-bot: @sana created ticket RW-3917 for "quant4x rollforward partial-kv-zeroing causes token duplication"

marc: hypothesis: quantized kernel memcpy path uses a packed stride and we accidentally skip a head-block copy when index wraps. int -> float unpack path masks zeroed sub-blocks, so float32 not affected. evan can you try a debug build with a forced memcpy_validator that checks per-head entropy after remap?

evan: will run with MEMCPY_CHECK=1 and a smaller longprefill to repro faster. ETA ~30m.

sana: temporary workaround for staging: set KV_ROLLFORWARD_STRICT=1 which forces full re-populate instead of remap. perf hit ~6% but eliminates dup in manual runs. leaving it on for the quant canary.

marc: good. add regression test to new-model-ci that runs quant4x longprefill -> continue and asserts no repeated token ngram > 3 across the boundary. also record per-head zero-count metric.

ci-bot: build 2025.06.12-quant4x-debug queued (owner: evan).

evan: quick data from MEMCPY_CHECK run: it flagged head-block 3 on shard 2 skipped during remap (copy_len reported 0). stack trace points to quant_kv_remap_packed() in kvcache_packed.c:line 427. attaching small grep.

sana: thanks. I'll open a PR with a conservative bound check and a unit test that simulates odd stride counts. PR will also add the per-head zero-count short-circuit metric.

marc: once PR is in, let's run the canary on a batch of 10 longprefill prompts (4k-8k) across quant4x and int8. aim to ship fix to staging by EOD if green.

sana: noted. keeping KV_ROLLFORWARD_STRICT on until we validate. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket RW-3917 updated: status=investigating, linked PR=NONE, labels=quant,kv,rollforward

evan: FYI the failure rate in initial canary w/strict=0 was ~4/20 runs. with strict=1 it's 0/20. will post logs after the debug build finishes.

marc: perfect. follow-up action items: 1) patch remap memcpy guard (sana) 2) add CI regression (marc) 3) add telemetry per-head zero-count (sana) 4) run cross-quant comparison on magnet-16b and magnet-7b (evan).
